facts.fact: 爆炸是「我」的死因，死后被关进一间全白的房间
facts.anchor: Wherever I thought I might end up after the explosion that killed me, this place wasn’t it.

facts.fact: 四人中有一个穿三件套戴礼帽的男人，自称政治家
facts.anchor: The man dressed in a three-piece suit and a bowler hat has been pacing this small space since we arrived.

facts.fact: 第三人是杀人犯，名字上过报纸，满口缺牙导致口齿不清
facts.anchor: The third man here with us is a murderer whose name I know from the papers.

facts.fact: 第四人是个拒绝报姓名的女人，蓬头垢面地盘腿坐在地上
facts.anchor: A bedraggled woman who refused to introduce herself earlier pointedly clears her throat from her cross-legged position on the floor.

facts.fact: 「我」提出的理论：四人原本都该下地狱，被关起来是酷刑
facts.anchor: If we were all bound for Hell—

facts.fact: 「我」说关禁闭直到发疯是地狱最好的开场
facts.anchor: then what better way to start off than by keeping us locked in here until we go mad?
a man with shoulder-length black hair wearing a long gray robe suddenly appears out of nowhere

facts.fact: 灰袍人说 Agency 缺人手
facts.anchor: we find ourselves short-staffed at the moment.

facts.fact: 条件：永恒提供舒适房间与三餐，并可免受地狱折磨
facts.anchor: As compensation, a comfortable room and regular meals will be provided for you for eternity. And you will be allowed to skip all that Hell nastiness.
And in return, we agree to…do what, exactly?

facts.fact: 「我」自陈生前既无礼又会用爆炸，把自己送上了路
facts.anchor: if there was one thing I was good at while living, it was being impertinent. And using explosives, too, I suppose. Fat lot of good that did me in the end.

facts.fact: 灰袍人只肯说工作是重要的、高尚的
facts.anchor: “Important work,” the man in the gray robe replies. “Noble work.”

facts.fact: 三人读完文件立刻签字
facts.anchor: After he explains exactly what the work is, the woman, the politician, and the murderer immediately sign the paperwork they’re presented with.
And after only a moment’s hesitation, so do I.
“Welcome, Friends,” the man in the gray robe says, “to the Agency.”
